reviews.text: cabrera & sons roofers llc replaced our roof with asphalt shingles. during the whole process, barry was professional, honest, and always quick to answer our calls and questions. the estimate for our roof was lower than what we got from two other companies, and after the job was done, we paid exactly what was quoted at the start—no hidden costs. the roofing crew arrived on time, worked hard in the texas heat, and were always friendly and polite while working on our house. they did an excellent job with the shingles and made sure to clean up thoroughly both during and after the project. we're very happy with the work and would highly recommend this company to anyone looking for reliable roofers in frisco.
reviews.author: cristina ruiz

reviews.text: The team did an outstanding job on my roof! The quality of their work was excellent, and they set very high standards. I had a metal roof and gutters installed in Frisco, and the whole process went smoothly. Nathaniel and his crew made sure everything was done right the first time and up to code. Barry was fantastic at overseeing the project and answering any questions I had along the way. The entire crew worked hard and showed real dedication to getting everything just right. The process was well-organized from start to finish. I highly recommend this roofer if you want great service and top-quality roofing work!
reviews.author: Donna N

reviews.text: Cabrera & Sons Roofers LLC is fantastic! from start to finish, the whole crew was professional and friendly. barry, the representative who came out to check my roof, really knew his stuff—he walked me through the entire roofing process step by step and made sure i understood what was happening. they handled the scheduling quickly, brought out the dumpster, and the roofing team arrived right on time the next day. they removed my old roof and put on new shingles all in just one day, which really impressed me. it was so easy because they handled everything with my insurance, and all i had to cover was my deductible. every person i dealt with was patient and answered all my questions, making the experience stress-free. i highly recommend using them for any roofing needs, and i’ll call again if i ever need roof work.
reviews.author: Jennifer Mcmahon

reviews.text: After a big storm in Frisco, I reached out to several roofing companies for help. Most of them pushed me to sign a contract right away, and wouldn’t even give me an estimate unless I agreed first. Cabrera & Sons Roofers LLC was different—they gave me a clear estimate with no pressure, just like I asked. That made me feel comfortable from the start. Once I picked them, the work on my roof went smoothly. There was a small leak after the replacement, but when I called about it, Nathaniel came out quickly and fixed it the next morning. I appreciated how fast they responded and made sure everything was right. In a business where you hear about high-pressure tactics and unreliable folks, this crew really stands out for being honest and dependable. Barry also explained how the insurance process works and gave tips that helped me get high-impact shingles covered, with no extra cost out of pocket. I definitely recommend this team for anyone in Frisco needing a reliable roofer, especially after Texas storms.
reviews.author: Jennifer Boone

reviews.text: we heard about this roofer from a couple of neighbors and now we understand why everyone recommends them. scheduling a free roof inspection and estimate was quick and straightforward. when barry came out to give the estimate, there was no pressure at all—unlike another company we tried before, which felt pushy and tried to sell us on things that were already included with this team. their quote was actually the best price we got, and i think the workmanship is even better than expected. they were able to get started much faster than others, which was important since we had a leak that needed attention right away. once the crew arrived, they worked quickly and treated our home with a lot of respect. the team cleaned up all the debris and took their time making sure our family, who was in and out during the project, wasn’t bothered. we’re very happy with how our new roof turned out and would definitely use this roofer again.
reviews.author: Tamara Wiggins

reviews.text: I found Cabrera & Sons Roofers LLC online when I needed roofing services for my home in Frisco. They quickly responded to my request to remove and replace my shingle roof, along with gutters and fascia, all as part of my insurance claim. The crew, including Barry, took care of my large roof project and finished everything in just one day, including a thorough cleanup. They offered a price lock guarantee, so my only out-of-pocket expense was my deductible, and all costs matched the final insurance-approved invoice. I didn’t have to make any down payment or pay until the job was completely finished, which gave me peace of mind. The team made it easy for me to choose the roof color, delivered all the materials on time, and installed everything just as promised. It was a smooth and hassle-free experience from start to finish, and I didn’t even have to leave my home. If you’re in Frisco and need a new roof or repairs, I highly recommend choosing this company for reliable and professional service.
reviews.author: Destiny Barry

reviews.text: After a huge tree fell on my house in Frisco, my roof had some serious damage with holes and water leaking inside. My insurance covered the repairs, which included taking off two layers of old shingles and installing a brand new roof over the whole house. The restoration company I worked with suggested Cabrera & Sons Roofers LLC for the job. Nathaniel from the team provided me with a list of homes they had recently reroofed, which helped me choose the perfect shingle color for my house. The roofing crew did a fantastic job—the new roof looks amazing! They paid close attention to detail, making sure no nails or debris were left behind in my yard, so there was no risk to my family or my car tires. Whenever I had questions about the roofing process, Barry always responded quickly and explained things in a friendly and helpful way. I’m very happy I went with this company for my new roof and would highly recommend them to anyone needing roofing work in Frisco.
reviews.author: Kerry30 B

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience working with this roofing company after a big storm damaged part of my roof. The whole team was professional and made the insurance process so much easier for me. From the first call, Barry and the crew were committed to helping me out and kept me updated every step of the way. Even though dealing with insurance can take a while, they stayed on top of things and made sure I got the funds needed for my roof repair. Once everything was approved, they finished the roof replacement quickly and efficiently, wrapping it up in just two weeks. I really appreciate their dedication and the quality work they did on my home. Highly recommend them if you need roofing help in Texas!
reviews.author: Donald Watkins

data.summary: The reviews appear highly authentic. They contain specific details about projects, crew members, and processes. The single mention of a minor issue (leak) that was promptly resolved adds credibility. The lack of negative reviews in the sample is notable but not definitive proof of manipulation, as the overall rating is 4.7 from 96 reviews, suggesting some critical feedback exists. The company demonstrates good follow-through on service issues.
fake_signals: All sampled reviews are from the last 3 months

positive_evidence: Quickly resolved a post-installation leak at no extra charge

authentic_signals: Specific project details (asphalt/metal roofs, gutters, fascia, insurance claims)
Mention of specific crew names (Barry, Nathaniel)
Mix of referral sources (neighbors, online, restoration company)
Mention of a resolved issue (leak) shows authenticity
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a consistent 4.7 rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
